soundness_flags.label: Definitions def:projection-test and def:lower-confidence-bound; Theorem 1
soundness_flags.one_line: The statistic and lower bound use t_alpha, but only t_q is declared and defined; explicitly set t_alpha=t_q evaluated at q=alpha.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 2 and Theorem 3
soundness_flags.one_line: Nonemptiness of P_K(a) does not ensure a null law or local d(P)>=r alternatives, and Theorem 3 omits feasibility restrictions on link constants; the minimax radius can otherwise degenerate.

soundness_flags.label: ass:wu-restricted-bridge
soundness_flags.one_line: Its justification merely restates that the condition holds when a bridge is smooth and box-bounded; Wu's solvability bridge need not be probability-valued, so no realistic generative condition currently supports this load-bearing restriction.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: ass:wu-theorem1-premise and the Wu-null consequence in Theorem 1
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The causal interpretation relies conditionally on Wu et al.'s published causal-null-to-solvability implication.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The causal claim is only: under the Wu Theorem 1 premises and existence of a solution in H_beta(R,eta), rejection falsifies that restricted observable bridge subnull; nonrejection does not identify a causal relation.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3.1, Proposition 1 and Theorem 1; Appendix B.1, Condition 7
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 derives p(y|x)=integral h(w,y)p(w|x)dw under the causal null and Proposition 1's completeness and regularity conditions.
The paper tests structural-function restrictions in NPIV using restricted/unrestricted sieve estimators and establishes adaptive composite-null testing rates.
The model is a Gaussian sequence inverse problem with known singular functions and Gaussian-noisy singular values, with upper and lower minimax separation results.
The paper gives nonasymptotic minimax radii for inverse Gaussian sequence testing with noisy operator observations and adaptive Bonferroni tests.
The paper develops bootstrap inference for constrained conditional-moment models through regularized local parameter spaces and uniform strong approximations.
The paper develops uniformly valid projection-based tests for restrictions forming convex cones, using cone monotonicity.

source_verification_receipts.version: IEEE Transactions on Information Theory 54(10), 2008, pp. 4750-4755
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies sparse multinomial uniformity testing through coincidence counts and establishes the characteristic sparse-sampling detection scale.
The paper establishes sharp null-probability-local minimax goodness-of-fit rates for binomial, Poisson, and multinomial models.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define t_alpha exactly, then state an explicit nondegenerate local-null/local-alternative submodel and admissible c_link,C_link range for every minimax claim.

Replace the circular probability-bridge rationale with a primitive finite-latent generative subclass that implies a smooth, uniformly interior solution, or present H_beta solely as a statistical diagnostic restriction.

Add a direct comparison theorem or boundary corollary relating the observed-image radius to Breunig and Chen's structural-space separation under a diagonal link, making the non-subsumption testable rather than verbal.

recommended_next_step: Revise this field-tier angle by repairing the statistic and minimax-domain definitions and by grounding the restricted-bridge assumption before advancing to Stage 0.
